newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta approves Canadian Western gas cost hike.
newsitem.headline: Alberta approves Canadian Western gas cost hike.

text.p: Alberta utility Canadian Western Natural Gas, a unit of ATCO Ltd, said on Friday that Alberta's regulator approved its request for an interim increase in the amount it charges customers for gas.

Canadian Western, which provides gas service to 355,000 customers in central and southern Alberta, said the Alberta Energy and Utilities Board approved an adjusted amount of C$2.789 per gigajoule for its gas cost recovery rate. The adjusted price is in effect from January 16 to March 31.
The previous rate was C$1.374 per GJ.
CWNG said the hike meant an average customer using 150 GJ a year would pay C$81 more for natural gas in 1997.
